Career

Hired Gun▾

Hired Guns are professional combatants who sell their martial skills to the highest bidder. They work as bodyguards, mercenaries, enforcers, and soldiers of fortune across the Outer Rim. Some are former military; others learned to fight in gladiatorial pits, street gangs, or planetary militias. What they share is an aptitude for violence and a practical understanding of its application.
